test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All shirts are pants.

All pants are ties.

No ties are jeans.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No jeans are pants.

(II) All pants are shirts.
solution:
Possible diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4d37c5a0e14e3be5bf55f83d7dc20708dba66a393bcc19adde0564b5b5eb168.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No jeans are pants → True (because all pants are ties and no ties are jeans So, no jeans are pants)

II. All pants are shirts → False (because all shirts are pants so, all pants are shirts is possible but not defined)

So, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4)".**
